title: Downtown Nashville Apartment - Steps from Broadway
description:
WALK anywhere DOWNTOWN! This newly renovated historic property is in the Heart of the entertainment district! Two blocks from Printer's Alley & Broadway (just a 5 minute walk to the Ryman Auditorium, Tootsies, or Bridgestone Arena!)

The space
Our 125 year old building is a registered historic site as part of the Fifth Avenue Historic District in Downtown Nashville! Renovated in 2020, the rooms at Woolworth Upstairs, once home to Woolworth department store, boast high ceilings, luxurious modern finishes, stainless appliances, memory foam mattresses, a Joybird sleeper sofa, and custom interiors. 50" HDTVs in every room and all the amenities to make yourself at home.

Guest access
Guests are provided access codes to the building's secure entry on 5th Ave N, the elevator, stairs and assigned a private access code to their apartment. Secure, private and easy!

Other things to note
Beds are dressed in fresh, white, combed cotton sateen sheets and duvets, with down-alternative pillows. All hypo-allergenic. Along with plush, white bath towels, hand towels, wash clothes and bath mats. We've also provided high-quality shampoo, conditioner, body wash and a hair dryer in the bathroom. Laundry and dish detergent provided.
